星口StarPort

Local proxy port manager

Prototype

Select a few nodes from your local Clash configuration, assign a local SOCKS port to each, and manage them from a web page.

The dashboard listens only on the local machine. Selected nodes are written to a managed runtime configuration; subscription addresses and node passwords are not shown. Adding or deleting saves the list, with port changes applied at startup.

Go · mihomoLocal web dashboard

Current status: An initial implementation is available without an official release. Build it yourself and provide your local configuration and mihomo.

Features and progress

  • Add or remove exits, configure ports, and start or stop them together
  • Manage only its own mihomo process while preserving existing Clash system proxy settings
  • Local status and exit APIs for tools and AI assistants

Platforms and distribution

The README documents local builds and configuration, with measurements on an Apple Silicon Mac. Consult repository verification for other platforms.

Start from source

These startup commands come from the repository README. Read the original documentation for dependencies and configuration.

go build -o starport ./cmd/starport
cp config.example.yaml config.yaml
./starport
